description: Switch Claude Code accounts per window or per repository without touching ~/.claude. Shared or isolated profiles, optional shared history.
cmd.setRepoDefault: Set default account for this repository
cmd.clearRepoDefault: Clear default account for this repository
cmd.toggleHistorySharing: Share / stop sharing history across accounts
cfg.scope: Where the selected account is remembered.
cfg.scope.workspace: Each window/repository remembers its own account (extension storage; nothing is written to the repository).
cfg.scope.user: A single account for every window (each window picks it up when reloaded).
cfg.accountsRoot: Folder where accounts are created. Empty = ~/.claude-accounts.
cfg.sharedItems: Items from ~/.claude that shared-profile accounts use through links. Credentials and .claude.json always stay per account.
cfg.shareHistory: All accounts use the same conversation history from ~/.claude. Use the 'Share history across accounts' command to turn this on or off: it merges existing history instead of discarding it.
cfg.historyItems: Items treated as history: per-folder conversations (projects), prompt history (history.jsonl), checkpoints (file-history), todos and plans.
cfg.autoApplyRepoDefault: When a repository is opened, automatically apply the default account set for it.
cfg.reloadBehavior: What to do after switching accounts (the Claude Code extension only reads the environment when it loads).
cfg.applyToTerminal: Also set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in this window's integrated terminals so the claude CLI uses the same account.
cfg.loginCommand: Command run in the terminal to log in to an account.
cfg.statusBarStyle: How the current account appears in the status bar.
cfg.statusBarStyle.name: Icon and full name, e.g. Claude: Work.
cfg.showPlan: Show the account's plan (e.g. Pro, Max 20x) in the status bar and the account picker, when Claude Code provides it.
cfg.rules: Default-account rules, checked in order when no default is set for the specific repository. A pattern starting with ~, / or a drive letter matches the folder path (e.g. ~/work/**); anything else matches the git remote (e.g. github.com/my-company/*). Without wildcards, a pattern also matches everything below it.
cfg.suggestSwitchOnLimit: When the current account hits its usage limit in this window, offer to switch to another account.
cfg.gravatar: Show the Gravatar of each account's e-mail in the account picker. Off by default: when on, the extension requests images from gravatar.com, sending a hash of the e-mail.
